# fw config

> Reference of the fw config command: Read or update ~/.fx/config.json. Usage, aliases and flags.

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/cli/config/

Read or update ~/.fx/config.json

## Usage

```bash
fw config <list|get|set>
```

## Subcommands

```bash
fw config list
fw config get
fw config set
```

The names come from the usage line.

## Global options

Every command also accepts `-C`, `--directory`, `--offline`, `--json`, `-q` and `-v`. See the [overview](/cli/).
